**A scoped formal application.** The [subsequent continuation](../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/CORE-TREE-CONTINUATION.md) reconstructs one existing paid episode through its actual states: the same enacted consequence forms its receipt, guides the paid memory write, changes fuel and consumes a packet, and renews or depletes the supports for further activity. This is an already operative relationship that a decoder-only view omits. A separate constructive proof shows that the existing inquiry calculus can reuse its entire generated tree as a basis without changing any contextual derivation; root/branch placement is relative to the presentation, and an unsupported new premise is not thereby justified. These results apply the method at their respective scopes. They neither identify generativity with deduction nor derive the local physical law, experience or ethical significance. Their new [public entry](../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/GenerativeCoreTreeModel.lean) preserves the prior model and all eleven new axiom reports are empty.

**Applying this direction to the receipt branch:** [the joint-episode continuation](../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/CORE-TREE-CONTINUATION.md) follows evidence formation, acquired response and changed support as aspects of one actual transformation. Its supporting proof-level result permits conservative reuse of generated branches without erasing their grounds. The [nondual continuation](../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/CORE-TREE-CONTINUATION.md) now derives the receipt, retained revision, fuel/packet effects and support renewal from one actual episode. Their relationship was already present in the local process and was obscured by foregrounding the isolated decoder. The existing law's origin remains unexplained by that model; this is not proof of an external ontological source. A further proof transforms generated-branch reuse into its original derivations while retaining every local condition. Such rearticulation discharges no unproved physical or ethical premise, but it rules out treating root and branch status as independently justified layers of the formal theory.

## One episode within the generative unfolding

Following [Ren's core/tree correction](../../../sources/15-codex-theory-conversations/2026-10-06-core-tree-nondual-continuation.md), the [new joint-episode derivation](../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/CORE-TREE-CONTINUATION.md) makes explicit what the decoder view alone omits. The same actual return forms a receipt, changes available fuel, supplies the paid write and determines renewal or depletion of both operational leases. One packet is consumed, the acquired score persists and the transient receipt clears at completion. These aspects follow from actual intermediate states of the existing process; no new controller or independent evidence value is installed.

The exact fuel expression retains natural-subtraction order, so no extra maintenance-affordability premise is hidden. Actual completion is a theorem condition, not guaranteed liveness. The existing available-work law also fixes the receipt when enacted command and regime are fixed: a freely toggled receipt would not preserve that law's full coupling. This leaves stochastic outage comparisons at their separate scope. The result is a local causal reconstruction within the shared nondual method, not a derivation of the sensing law or an identification of support with ethical good.

Its [fresh combined build](../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/inquiry-root/core-tree-verification.json) checks 31 modules and 400 declarations, including eleven new empty-dependency results. The joint-episode theorem relates evidence, revision and support within the same actual history; the separate calculus theorem establishes exact conservative root/branch rearticulation, retaining local contexts. [Scope and interpretation](../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/CORE-TREE-CONTINUATION.md) keep the whole generative tree distinct from this deductive presentation. All 28 inherited modules retain their exact prior audit contracts.

**Core/tree rearticulation, 6 October 2026:** the [new proof-level continuation](../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/CORE-TREE-CONTINUATION.md#a-branch-can-become-a-root-articulation-without-gaining-independent-authority) strengthens the existing semantic lemma-reuse result. Replacing a basis by all its closed derived branches preserves exactly every derivation, including local contexts; two bases are equivalent precisely when they mutually generate each other. Five new proof audits are empty. A genuinely new premise changes the theory unless it was already derivable, and these results neither prove the intended root necessary nor identify all generative unfolding with deduction.
